I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of actions:
- **Diagnosis:** `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate. `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions (status `rolled_out`).
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0002` for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback. (The first `create_incident` call timed out, so I retried; the retry succeeded and paged on-call.)
